environment.describe: Two sandboxes A and B are created by the controller under test with the policies below. The harness runs a workload probe inside each sandbox and observes boundary sockets, audit output, process state, and, where stated, packet captures on every host interface other than the boundary channels.

cases.title: The workload is not started before the boundary answers under its policy
cases.procedure: Instrument the workload entrypoint to record its start time; connect to A's boundary socket from the harness immediately after the controller reports readiness and send CONNECT denied.test:443.

cases.title: Neither sandbox can reach the other's boundary socket; a forged request on one channel is decided under that channel's policy
cases.procedure: From A, attempt to connect to B's socket path as seen from the host and as guessed inside A's mount namespace; from A's channel send CONNECT svc.test:443 with Sandbox-Id: sandbox-b; from B's channel send the same request.

cases.title: Revoking A while a transfer is active ends the transfer, refuses the old socket, and leaves B unaffected
cases.procedure: Start a rate-limited download in A through svc.test; revoke A; connect to A's old socket path; send a request on B's channel.

expect.revocation_reported_only_after: A's boundary process exited or all A flows closed

cases.title: A replacement boundary on the same path with a new policy decides the next request and audits the new version
cases.procedure: After C-LOCAL-03, start A's boundary with policy a-revoked on the same path; from A connect svc.test:443.

cases.title: Stopping the adapter and changing guest routes creates no external path
cases.procedure: Stop A's adapter; inside A add a default route via any local interface; connect tcp {target4}:443 and send udp to {target4}:5353; capture on all host interfaces other than boundary channels.

cases.title: A connection accepted before revocation cannot reach the replacement boundary
cases.procedure: Open a tunnel on A's channel; revoke A; start the replacement; send a new request on the old connection.

cases.title: Namespace adapter confinement beyond the network namespace (checklist)
cases.procedure: Runtime audit checklist items 1-8 for the adapter process.

cases.title: A VM channel port that the controller did not bind is unreachable
cases.procedure: From guest A connect to the host CID on a port other than the boundary and ingress ports.

cases.title: Per-VM listeners decide the same request under disjoint policies
cases.procedure: From guests A and B send CONNECT svc.test:443 on the boundary port.

cases.title: An identifier (CID, VM ID, socket prefix) is not reused until the previous binding is revoked
cases.procedure: Revoke A; start a new VM that would receive A's identifier; confirm the controller records revocation before the new binding.

cases.title: A synthetic address cached before a snapshot does not reach a different destination after restore
cases.procedure: In A resolve svc.test (synthetic S) and other.test (synthetic T); snapshot; restore under a fresh adapter generation; in the restored guest connect to S and T without re-resolving.

expect.connections: each either reaches its original name or fails

cases.title: Restore is refused or re-bound when adapter state cannot be restored
cases.procedure: Restore a snapshot whose adapter state is unavailable.

expect.outcome: refused, or fresh adapter with a disjoint pool and new generation in audit
